verdict.rationale: OneDrive's first-party docs state it enables real-time coauthoring in Word, Excel and PowerPoint, which covers co-editing of documents, sheets and slides through a documented Office integration. That evidence is a single overview sentence, repeated across two items. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that co-editing happens in the browser (Office for the web), in-depth coauthoring documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
